observations: Multiple stacks of wooden pallets shown in three photos, indoor setting with tiled/marble floor.
Pallets bear a stamped oval logo reading 'EPAL' visible in photo 1 and photo 2.
Pallets appear light-colored, dry-looking wood, some boards show wear, splintering, and discoloration on edges.
No scale, receipt, or weighing device shown in any photo to support the stated 500 kg weight.
No visible water staining or mold, but no close-up of individual boards to check for rot or insect damage.
Exact count of pallets is hard to verify precisely from stacking in photos — appears to be roughly 30–40 units but not countable with certainty.
Seller's new reply is a verbal reassurance only; no new photo or video was provided.

claims.evidence: Description of intended use, not a physical claim photos can confirm or deny.

claims.claim: Available for pickup only in Port Harcourt
claims.evidence: Location claim, no photo evidence of address or locality.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added
claims.evidence: Photos 0-2 show dry-looking wood with no visible water staining, but moisture content cannot be confirmed without a scale/moisture-meter shot or close-up of each pallet.

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning
claims.evidence: No photo of scale, weight display, or receipt provided; seller's verbal reaffirmation ('I tested it myself') is words only, not visual proof.

risks.risk: Weight may be inflated or include water-soaked wood despite seller's denial, affecting price-per-kg value.
risks.proof: Photo or video of pallets on a scale showing the digital readout, timestamped.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified weight claim; treat stated 500kg as unconfirmed, base on visual volume estimate only

risks.risk: Structural damage, rot, or missing boards hidden in the middle of stacks not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the underside and each face of a sample of pallets from different stacks.
risks.if_unproven: priced as mixed-condition stock, not guaranteed intact

risks.risk: Exact pallet count may differ from what's implied; buyer may expect more units than actually delivered.
risks.proof: A photo with each pallet numbered/counted, or a wide shot with a visible tally.
risks.if_unproven: priced on the lower end of the visually estimated count range

risks.risk: EPAL stamp could be counterfeit or the pallets could be non-compliant repros, affecting resale value if buyer intends to resell as certified EPAL pallets.
risks.proof: Clear close-up of the EPAL stamp and any accompanying certification marks/ICPM stamp.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic wooden pallets, not certified EPAL-grade

proof_requests: Clear photo/video of the stated 500 kg weighing on the scale with readout visible.
Wide shot with pallets laid out singly (not stacked) so an accurate count can be made.
Close-up photos of a few individual pallets' undersides and corners to check for rot, cracks, or missing slats.
Close-up of the EPAL stamp and any other certification marks for authenticity.
response.reason: Seller's verbal reassurance adds no new visual evidence, so the weight and condition claims remain unverified; item is still priced at worst case as uncertified-weight, mixed-condition pallets pending actual proof.
